```{r}

# ============================================================
# DATA 101 CAPSTONE: BEATING EXPECTATIONS
# Actual vs. Expected Life Expectancy
# Interactive Dumbbell Chart - Shiny + Plotly
#
# Model: Life expectancy ~ log(GDP per capita)
# Performance = Actual - Expected (in years)
# ============================================================

# PART 1: PACKAGES

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)


# PART 2: LOAD DATA

files <- list.files(
  ".",
  pattern = "^wdi_clean(\\([0-9]+\\))?\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  files <- list.files(
    "~",
    pattern = "^wdi_clean(\\([0-9]+\\))?\\.csv$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
}

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot find wdi_clean.csv in your RStudio folders.")
}

preferred <- files[
  basename(files) == "wdi_clean.csv"
]

data_path <- if (length(preferred) > 0) {
  preferred[1]
} else {
  files[1]
}

data <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

required <- c(
  "country", "iso3c", "region", "year",
  "gdp_per_capita", "life_expect"
)

missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))

if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  )
}


# PART 3: CLEAN DATA

graph_data <- data %>%
  transmute(
    country = as.character(country),
    iso3c = as.character(iso3c),
    region = as.character(region),
    year = as.integer(year),
    gdp_per_capita = as.numeric(gdp_per_capita),
    life_expect = as.numeric(life_expect)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(country),
    !is.na(iso3c),
    !is.na(region),
    !is.na(year),
    is.finite(gdp_per_capita),
    is.finite(life_expect),
    gdp_per_capita > 0,
    life_expect > 0,
    life_expect <= 110
  ) %>%
  distinct(iso3c, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (nrow(graph_data) == 0) {
  stop("No valid GDP and life expectancy observations found.")
}


# PART 4: DEFAULT SETTINGS

available_years <- sort(unique(graph_data$year))

default_year <- if (2022 %in% available_years) {
  2022
} else {
  max(available_years)
}

all_regions <- sort(unique(graph_data$region))
all_countries <- sort(unique(graph_data$country))


# PART 5: USER INTERFACE

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Beating Expectations: Who Lives Longer Than Income Predicts?"),

  p(
    "Compare actual life expectancy with the life expectancy
     predicted from each country's GDP per capita."
  ),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      sliderInput(
        "year",
        "Select Year:",
        min = min(available_years),
        max = max(available_years),
        value = default_year,
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),

      selectInput(
        "ranking",
        "Which Countries Should Be Displayed?",
        choices = c(
          "Top Overperformers" = "top",
          "Bottom Underperformers" = "bottom",
          "Top and Bottom" = "both",
          "Selected Countries" = "selected"
        ),
        selected = "both"
      ),

      sliderInput(
        "n_countries",
        "Number of Countries per Group:",
        min = 5,
        max = 20,
        value = 10,
        step = 1
      ),

      selectInput(
        "region",
        "Filter by Region:",
        choices = c("All Regions", all_regions),
        selected = "All Regions"
      ),

      selectizeInput(
        "countries",
        "Select or Highlight Countries:",
        choices = all_countries,
        selected = character(0),
        multiple = TRUE,
        options = list(
          placeholder = "Search for countries"
        )
      ),

      checkboxInput(
        "highlight_us",
        "Highlight United States",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      checkboxInput(
        "show_labels",
        "Show Performance Labels",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      checkboxInput(
        "show_us",
        "Include U.S. Even If Outside Rankings",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      actionButton(
        "reset",
        "Reset Filters"
      ),

      hr(),

      h4("How to Read This Graph"),

      tags$ul(
        tags$li(
          strong("Gray dot: "),
          "Expected life expectancy based on GDP per capita."
        ),
        tags$li(
          strong("Blue dot: "),
          "Actual life expectancy above expectations."
        ),
        tags$li(
          strong("Red dot: "),
          "Actual life expectancy below expectations."
        ),
        tags$li(
          strong("Connecting line: "),
          "The difference between actual and expected."
        ),
        tags$li(
          strong("Positive score: "),
          "Country lives longer than predicted."
        ),
        tags$li(
          strong("Negative score: "),
          "Country lives fewer years than predicted."
        )
      ),

      hr(),

      h4("Model Information"),

      p(
        "Expected life expectancy is calculated using
         a linear regression of life expectancy on
         the natural logarithm of GDP per capita."
      ),

      p(
        "The model is fitted using all countries
         with valid data in the selected year.
         Region filters change which countries are
         displayed, not the prediction model."
      ),

      p(
        "Sources: World Bank GDP per capita
         and life expectancy."
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(

      plotlyOutput(
        "dumbbell_plot",
        height = "850px"
      ),

      h4("Summary Statistics"),

      fluidRow(
        column(
          4,
          strong(textOutput("country_count"))
        ),
        column(
          4,
          strong(textOutput("model_r2"))
        ),
        column(
          4,
          strong(textOutput("us_result"))
        )
      ),

      hr(),

      h4("Country Performance Table"),

      tableOutput("performance_table"),

      hr(),

      h4("Interpretation"),

      textOutput("interpretation"),

      br(),

      p(
        "Note: The model identifies statistical
         overperformance and underperformance.
         It does not establish what causes the differences."
      )
    )
  )
)


# ============================================================
# PART 6: SERVER
# ============================================================

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # 6A: FIT A NEW MODEL FOR EACH YEAR

  model_data <- reactive({

    df <- graph_data %>%
      filter(year == input$year)

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 10,
        "Not enough country observations for this year."
      ),
      need(
        n_distinct(df$gdp_per_capita) >= 3,
        "Not enough income variation for a regression."
      )
    )

    # Predict life expectancy from log income

    model <- lm(
      life_expect ~ log(gdp_per_capita),
      data = df
    )

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        expected_life = as.numeric(
          predict(model, newdata = df)
        ),

        performance = life_expect - expected_life,

        performance_type = if_else(
          performance >= 0,
          "Above Expectations",
          "Below Expectations"
        )
      )

    list(
      data = df,
      model = model
    )
  })


  # 6B: FILTER REGIONS

  region_data <- reactive({

    df <- model_data()$data

    if (input$region != "All Regions") {
      df <- df %>%
        filter(region == input$region)
    }

    df
  })


  # 6C: CHOOSE COUNTRIES TO DISPLAY

  displayed_data <- reactive({

    df <- region_data()

    if (input$ranking == "top") {

      selected <- df %>%
        slice_max(
          performance,
          n = input$n_countries,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

    } else if (input$ranking == "bottom") {

      selected <- df %>%
        slice_min(
          performance,
          n = input$n_countries,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

    } else if (input$ranking == "both") {

      top <- df %>%
        slice_max(
          performance,
          n = input$n_countries,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

      bottom <- df %>%
        slice_min(
          performance,
          n = input$n_countries,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

      selected <- bind_rows(top, bottom) %>%
        distinct(iso3c, .keep_all = TRUE)

    } else {

      selected <- df %>%
        filter(country %in% input$countries)
    }

    # Always include selected countries for comparison

    if (
      length(input$countries) > 0 &&
      input$ranking != "selected"
    ) {

      extra <- df %>%
        filter(country %in% input$countries)

      selected <- bind_rows(selected, extra) %>%
        distinct(iso3c, .keep_all = TRUE)
    }

    # Include the U.S. when requested,
    # provided it is in the selected region.

    if (
      input$show_us &&
      input$ranking != "selected"
    ) {

      us <- df %>%
        filter(iso3c == "USA")

      selected <- bind_rows(selected, us) %>%
        distinct(iso3c, .keep_all = TRUE)
    }

    selected %>%
      arrange(performance) %>%
      mutate(
        country_order = factor(
          country,
          levels = unique(country)
        )
      )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # PART 7: INTERACTIVE DUMBBELL CHART
  # ==========================================================

  output$dumbbell_plot <- renderPlotly({

    df <- displayed_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) > 0,
        "No countries available. Change your selection."
      )
    )

    # Calculate vertical positions

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        y_position = seq_len(n()),

        is_us = iso3c == "USA",

        actual_color = case_when(
          is_us & input$highlight_us ~ "#7C3AED",
          performance >= 0 ~ "#1686C1",
          TRUE ~ "#D85A57"
        ),

        Hover = paste0(
          "<b>", country, "</b>",
          "<br>Year: ", year,
          "<br>Region: ", region,
          "<br>GDP per capita: $",
          format(
            round(gdp_per_capita, 0),
            big.mark = ","
          ),
          "<br>Expected life expectancy: ",
          round(expected_life, 2), " years",
          "<br>Actual life expectancy: ",
          round(life_expect, 2), " years",
          "<br>Performance: ",
          sprintf("%+.2f", performance),
          " years"
        )
      )

    p <- plot_ly()

    # Connecting lines for each country

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

      p <- p %>%
        add_segments(
          x = df$expected_life[i],
          xend = df$life_expect[i],
          y = df$y_position[i],
          yend = df$y_position[i],

          line = list(
            color = if (
              df$is_us[i] && input$highlight_us
            ) {
              "#7C3AED"
            } else {
              "#A1A1AA"
            },
            width = if (
              df$is_us[i] && input$highlight_us
            ) 5 else 3
          ),

          inherit = FALSE,
          hoverinfo = "skip",
          showlegend = FALSE
        )
    }

    # Expected dots

    p <- p %>%
      add_markers(
        x = df$expected_life,
        y = df$y_position,

        text = paste0(
          df$country,
          "<br>Expected: ",
          round(df$expected_life, 2),
          " years"
        ),

        hoverinfo = "text",

        marker = list(
          color = "#94A3B8",
          size = 10,
          line = list(
            color = "white",
            width = 1
          )
        ),

        name = "Expected",
        showlegend = TRUE,
        inherit = FALSE
      )

    # Actual dots, colored by performance

    p <- p %>%
      add_markers(
        x = df$life_expect,
        y = df$y_position,

        text = df$Hover,
        hoverinfo = "text",

        marker = list(
          color = df$actual_color,
          size = ifelse(
            df$is_us & input$highlight_us,
            15,
            11
          ),
          line = list(
            color = "white",
            width = 1
          )
        ),

        name = "Actual",
        showlegend = TRUE,
        inherit = FALSE
      )

    # Optional performance labels

    if (input$show_labels) {

      df <- df %>%
        mutate(
          label_x = pmax(
            life_expect,
            expected_life
          ) + 0.7,

          score_label = sprintf(
            "%+.1f",
            performance
          )
        )

      p <- p %>%
        add_text(
          x = df$label_x,
          y = df$y_position,

          text = df$score_label,
          textposition = "middle right",

          textfont = list(
            size = 11,
            color = "#333333"
          ),

          hoverinfo = "skip",
          showlegend = FALSE,
          inherit = FALSE
        )
    }

    # Automatic X-axis limits

    x_min <- floor(
      min(
        c(df$expected_life, df$life_expect),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) - 3
    )

    x_max <- ceiling(
      max(
        c(df$expected_life, df$life_expect),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) + 5
    )

    # Final chart

    p %>%
      layout(

        title = list(
          text = paste0(
            "Actual vs. Expected Life Expectancy (",
            input$year,
            ")"
          )
        ),

        xaxis = list(
          title = "Life Expectancy (Years)",
          range = c(x_min, x_max),
          zeroline = FALSE
        ),

        yaxis = list(
          title = "",
          tickmode = "array",
          tickvals = df$y_position,
          ticktext = df$country,
          range = c(0.5, nrow(df) + 0.5),
          autorange = FALSE,
          automargin = TRUE
        ),

        legend = list(
          orientation = "h",
          x = 0.3,
          y = -0.12
        ),

        hovermode = "closest",

        margin = list(
          t = 90,
          b = 100,
          l = 170,
          r = 65
        )
      )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # PART 8: SUMMARY STATISTICS
  # ==========================================================

  output$country_count <- renderText({

    paste(
      "Model countries:",
      nrow(model_data()$data)
    )
  })


  output$model_r2 <- renderText({

    r2 <- summary(model_data()$model)$r.squared

    paste0(
      "Model R-squared: ",
      round(r2, 3)
    )
  })


  output$us_result <- renderText({

    us <- model_data()$data %>%
      filter(iso3c == "USA")

    if (nrow(us) == 0) {
      return("U.S. data unavailable")
    }

    paste0(
      "U.S. performance: ",
      sprintf("%+.2f", us$performance[1]),
      " years"
    )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # PART 9: COUNTRY PERFORMANCE TABLE
  # ==========================================================

  output$performance_table <- renderTable({

    df <- displayed_data()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      arrange(desc(performance)) %>%
      transmute(
        Country = country,
        Region = region,
        `GDP per Capita` = round(gdp_per_capita, 0),
        `Expected Life` = round(expected_life, 2),
        `Actual Life` = round(life_expect, 2),
        `Difference (Years)` = round(performance, 2)
      )

  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)


  # ==========================================================
  # PART 10: AUTOMATIC INTERPRETATION
  # ==========================================================

  output$interpretation <- renderText({

    df <- displayed_data()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      return("No countries selected.")
    }

    top_country <- df %>%
      slice_max(performance, n = 1)

    bottom_country <- df %>%
      slice_min(performance, n = 1)

    paste0(
      "Among the displayed countries in ",
      input$year,
      ", ",
      top_country$country,
      " has the largest positive performance score (",
      sprintf("%+.2f", top_country$performance),
      " years), while ",
      bottom_country$country,
      " has the lowest score (",
      sprintf("%+.2f", bottom_country$performance),
      " years). ",
      "These differences are measured relative to the ",
      "global income-based prediction model for that year."
    )
  })


  # ==========================================================
  # PART 11: RESET FILTERS
  # ==========================================================

  observeEvent(input$reset, {

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "year",
      value = default_year
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "ranking",
      selected = "both"
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "n_countries",
      value = 10
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "region",
      selected = "All Regions"
    )

    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "countries",
      selected = character(0)
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "highlight_us",
      value = TRUE
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "show_labels",
      value = TRUE
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "show_us",
      value = TRUE
    )
  })
}


# ============================================================
# PART 12: RUN SHINY APP
# ============================================================

shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)

```
